dossier.purpose: actionlint (kjanat fork of rhysd/actionlint) is a Go static checker for GitHub Actions workflow files: syntax, `${{ }}` expression typing, `uses:`/`with:` and step-output checks against local action metadata and an embedded popular-actions dataset, reusable-workflow checks, and ShellCheck/pyflakes runs on `run:` scripts (README.md:7-20; docs/checks.md:5-48). The fork adds three default-on cache-safety policies and opt-in policy checks (require-commit-hash, require-permissions, require-job-timeout, required-actions) read from .github/actionlint.yaml (README.md:9; docs/config.md:118-394). It is delivered as a CLI binary, Go library (module actionlint.kjanat.dev), Docker image, first-party Docker GitHub Action, pre-commit hooks, npm launcher package and Nix flake (README.md:9; docs/install.md). The product does not itself generate SBOMs, attestations, dependency-update PRs or code-scanning alerts; the repository's own pipeline uses Syft via GoReleaser, BuildKit sbom/provenance, actions/attest-build-provenance, Dependabot plus peter-evans/create-pull-request, and CodeQL (.goreleaser.yaml:38-41; .github/workflows/release.yml:58-72,174-255; .github/dependabot.yml:4-21; .github/workflows/upkeep.yml:55-75; .github/workflows/codeql.yml:41-54).

claims.claim: actionlint is a static checker for GitHub Actions workflow files; an online playground runs it in the browser through WebAssembly.

Fork of rhysd/actionlint that carries the upstream checks plus cache safety policies enabled by default, configurable opt-in policy checks, composite action step validation, shell completion and a first-party GitHub Action; it ships attested binaries, a Docker image on GHCR and Docker Hub, and a Go module at actionlint.kjanat.dev.

Features: syntax check of workflow files; strong type check of `${{ }}` expressions; actions usage check of `with:` inputs and `steps.{id}.outputs`; reusable workflow check; ShellCheck and pyflakes integrations for `run:`; security checks (script injection by untrusted inputs, hard-coded credentials); glob, `needs:`, runner-label and cron validation.
actionlint focuses on finding mistakes and tries to catch as many errors as possible while keeping false positives minimal.
Install with npm, Homebrew, AUR, Scoop or mise, or download a release archive; `npx @kjanat/actionlint`; `go install actionlint.kjanat.dev/cmd/actionlint@latest`.

The GitHub Action is a Docker action backed by a prebuilt image containing actionlint, ShellCheck and pyflakes; it reports GitHub annotations by default, runs only on Linux, needs a reachable Docker daemon, and does not support `ubuntu-slim`.

The moving `v1` and `v1.16` tags point to a commit that pins the published container image by digest; `v1.17.0` is a versioned release tag; for an immutable reference use the full commit SHA resolved from a floating tag.
Action `format` input accepts github, default, oneline, json, json-lines, markdown or sarif; outputs are exit-code, result, problems-found, problem-count, output and output-file.
Four pre-commit hooks: `actionlint` (built with Go), `actionlint-shellcheck` (adds a Go build of ShellCheck), `actionlint-docker` (GHCR image), `actionlint-system` (executable on PATH).
The README demo section is generated from the checked fixture files by scripts/check-readme, so it cannot drift; the fork 1.16.1 demo reports `expression`, `require-commit-hash` and `parallel-steps`.
Configuration document covers runner labels, variables, secrets, default permissions, error filters, opt-in policy checks and YAML Language Server schema support.

Installation document covers npm, Homebrew, AUR, Scoop, aqua, mise, the community pip/uv wrapper, release archives, the download script, Docker and Go, and the status of WinGet and upstream-only package names.
Problems are reported through this fork's issue tracker.
actionlint is distributed under the MIT license.

install.method: Release archive via gh, with attestation verification
install.command:
gh release download --repo kjanat/actionlint --pattern '*_linux_amd64.tar.gz' v1.17.0
tar xf actionlint_1.17.0_linux_amd64.tar.gz
./actionlint -version
gh attestation verify -R kjanat/actionlint actionlint_1.17.0_linux_amd64.tar.gz

readme.telemetry_and_network: No telemetry, analytics or phone-home code found. The lint path is offline: the root package, cmd/actionlint and cmd/actionlint-action import no net/http (net/url only parses a Docker image reference, rule_action.go:772); popular-action metadata is embedded (docs/checks.md:2038-2039; popular_actions.go:5-7); remote reusable workflows are not downloaded (docs/config.md:139; docs/checks.md:2887); the only subprocesses are the optional shellcheck/pyflakes found on PATH or given with -shellcheck/-pyflakes (process.go:25-26,123-137; linter.go:619-638). Network is used by: `make build`/`go generate` (CONTRIBUTING.md:79-81; scripts/generate-*), whereas plain `go build` and `go install` use checked-in generated sources; install paths (GitHub releases, npm registry, GHCR/Docker Hub; download script uses curl, scripts/download-actionlint.bash:49,127, and runs `gh attestation verify` only when an authenticated gh exists, :129-134); and the Docker action, which needs a reachable Docker daemon and pulls ghcr.io/kjanat/actionlint:action-1.17.0 (README.md:145; action.yml:75) but declares no token or secret input (action.yml:7-52). No account is needed to run the tool. The browser playground runs the WASM build locally and states it sends no data outside the browser (docs/usage.md:451-452); it fetches a user-supplied URL only when opened with a `u` query parameter (playground/src/index.ts:94-97). Maintainer-only services: GHCR, Docker Hub, npm trusted publishing via OIDC, Homebrew/Scoop/WinGet/AUR tokens and Codecov via OIDC (.github/workflows/release.yml:62-70,144-148; .github/workflows/npm-release.yml:163-170; .github/workflows/ci.yml:60-61).

entry_points.what: CLI binary: builds actionlint.Command with stdin/stdout/stderr and exits with Command.Main(os.Args) (main.go:11-17).
Library entry: NewLinter plus LintRepository/LintDir/LintFiles/LintStdin; assembles the rule set per file (linter.go:540-699).
Docker GitHub Action wrapper (inputs, format rendering incl. SARIF, GITHUB_OUTPUT, output-file); image ENTRYPOINT in Dockerfile:21-23; action definition in action.yml:73-85.
js/wasm build behind the browser playground (UI in playground/src/index.ts, bundled with Vite).
npm launcher: resolves the platform package binary and spawns it, forwarding argv and exit status (lib/launch.mjs:13-34).
Four pre-commit hooks: actionlint, actionlint-docker, actionlint-system, actionlint-shellcheck.
Release download script with optional gh attestation verification (lines 129-134).

code.architecture: One flat Go package `actionlint.kjanat.dev` in the repository root (64 production .go files and 77 test files). Pipeline: Linter (linter.go) discovers the project and config (project.go; config.go with the Policy struct at :64-113; `.github/actionlint.yaml|yml` loaded at :488-491), parses workflow YAML into an AST (parse.go -> ast.go, on go.yaml.in/yaml/v4), then runs a fixed list of Rule visitors (rule.go, pass.go) per file: rule_action.go, rule_expression.go, rule_permissions.go, rule_workflow_call.go, rule_events.go, rule_matrix.go, rule_runner_label.go, rule_credentials.go, rule_shellcheck.go, rule_pyflakes.go, etc. Policy rules are added only when configured (rule_require_commit_hash.go, rule_require_permissions.go, rule_require_job_timeout.go, rule_required_actions.go; linter.go:602-613) while the three cache policies (rule_cache_policy.go, rule_workflow_call_cache.go) are default-on (linter.go:614-618). Expression `${{ }}` lexer, parser, type checker and untrusted-input detector live in expr_*.go (expr_insecure.go). Local action and reusable-workflow metadata loaders: action_metadata*.go, reusable_workflow.go. Generated data tables: popular_actions.go, all_webhooks.go, availability.go, action_metadata_availability.go, action_runtimes.go (produced by scripts/generate-* through `go generate`, refreshed weekly by .github/workflows/upkeep.yml). External-linter runner: process.go. Output: error.go (templates, JSON, pretty print), sarif.go with sarif_template.txt, completion.go, inline_suppression*.go. Satellites: cmd/actionlint-action, playground (wasm + TypeScript UI), distribution/npm (launcher and packaging), nix/ and flake.nix, packages/changelog-feed (RSS reader/monitor), .github/actions/* (7 composite CI actions), scripts/* (generators, bump-version, check-checks, check-readme, fetch-conformance). A split of the root package into subpackages is planned but unchanged in code (docs/design/package-layout.md:1-8).
code.packaging_and_release: Trigger: push of a tag matching v*.*.* (.github/workflows/release.yml:2); top-level `contents: read` with per-job elevation (release.yml:9,45,77,89,261); all 90 `uses:` refs under .github are pinned to 40-hex commit SHAs (checked by grep over .github). Binaries: GoReleaser v2.18.0 (release.yml:60-61) builds ./cmd/actionlint for darwin amd64/arm64, linux 386/arm/amd64/arm64, windows 386/amd64/arm64, freebsd 386/amd64 with CGO_ENABLED=0 and version ldflags (.goreleaser.yaml:13-36); tar.gz archives (zip on Windows) carry README, LICENSE, docs and the man page (:47-60); source tarball (:62-67); SHA-256 checksums file (:43-45); SPDX SBOM per archive generated by Syft (`sboms: artifacts: archive`, :38-41; CONTRIBUTING.md:319; Syft installed at release.yml:58-59); build-provenance attestation of the checksums file with actions/attest-build-provenance (release.yml:71-72); post-release download check (release.yml:73-74). Images: CLI image (ghcr.io and docker.io) and action image (ghcr.io only), linux/amd64+arm64, BuildKit `sbom: true` and `provenance: mode=max` (release.yml:174-189,222-237), smoke-tested before push (:162-173,:210-221), image digests attested with actions/attest-build-provenance (:238-255; CHANGELOG.md:134). Floating tags v1 and v1.17 are moved to a bot commit that pins the action image digest in action.yml, after verifying the release commit signature (release.yml:256-317). npm: reusable npm-release.yml publishes 11 platform packages then the launcher through OIDC trusted publishing with npm provenance (npm-release.yml:159-207; distribution/npm/README.md:92-130); binaries are verified against the release checksums manifest before repackaging (.github/actions/npm-packages/main.go:209-263; distribution/npm/README.md:43-49). Other channels: Homebrew cask in kjanat/tap, Scoop bucket, AUR -bin and source packages (.goreleaser.yaml:69-123,176-273) plus AUR -git (.github/workflows/aur-git.yml), WinGet manifests generated but upload paused (.goreleaser.yaml:154-155), Nix flake (flake.nix), Go module via vanity path (playground/index.html:10), community-maintained PyPI wrapper (docs/install.md:297-323). Other documented install commands: `paru -S actionlint-kjanat-bin` (docs/install.md:49), `mise use github:kjanat/actionlint` (:203), `aqua g -i kjanat/actionlint` (:192), `nix run github:kjanat/actionlint -- --help` (:261). CONTRIBUTING.md:301 states published release tags and assets are immutable. No cosign/detached signature files and no reproducible-build claim found; the release builds block sets no -trimpath or mod_timestamp (.goreleaser.yaml:13-36).
code.tests_and_ci: Go `testing` with go-cmp: table-driven and golden-file tests over testdata/ (examples, err, ok, projects, config, format) - CONTRIBUTING.md:174-190. About 99 Go `_test.go` files (77 in the root package, 6 in cmd/actionlint-action, 4 in fuzz/, 1 in internal/conformance, 10 under scripts/, 1 in .github/actions/npm-packages) plus about 7 JS/TS test files (node --test; Vitest in playground/src/test.ts). Native Go fuzz targets in fuzz/ (CONTRIBUTING.md:226-244); upstream conformance suite behind build tag `conformance` (docs/conformance.md; Makefile:56-59); micro-benchmarks `go test -bench Lint -benchmem` over testdata/bench (Makefile:118-119) with no published results. Tests need git, bash, ShellCheck and pyflakes on PATH (CONTRIBUTING.md:113-115). 19 workflow files in .github/workflows: ci.yml (push to master and PRs: unit tests on ubuntu-26.04 x64/arm, macos-latest, macos-26-intel, windows x64/arm; `go test -race` with coverage uploaded to Codecov via OIDC; dog-fooding actionlint on the repo's own workflows with the problem matcher; wasm playground build/test/lint; GoReleaser snapshot with Syft; tests of the local action modules; golangci-lint v2.13.1, `go mod tidy -diff`, govulncheck via `make lint`, shellcheck of scripts; Dockerfile build, hadolint and droast; Docker action image test; pre-commit ShellCheck hook test), codeql.yml (CodeQL for go, javascript-typescript and actions; push, PR, weekly), conformance.yml (3 OSes), generated-content.yml (regenerates tables and fails on diff), readme-demo.yml, matcher.yml, download.yml (download script on 3 OSes), nix.yml (3 systems), autofix.yml (dprint and modernize through autofix.ci), comment-cop.yml (pull_request_target review bot), upkeep.yml (weekly PRs: regenerated Go tables, README demo, Go toolchain bump, go-shellcheck bump), changelog-monitor.yml (daily issues from GitHub's Actions changelog feed), release.yml, npm-release.yml, changelog-release.yml, aur-git.yml, pages.yml (publishing), and manual major-tag.yml and expr-conformance-probe.yml. CI installs ShellCheck 0.11.0 with SHA-256 verification (.github/actions/setup-shellcheck/action.yml:8,74-89) and Pandoc with `gh release verify-asset` (.github/actions/setup-pandoc/action.yml:51).
code.dependencies: go.mod (root): 14 direct requires (doublestar/v4, fatih/color, google/go-cmp, invopop/jsonschema, mattn/go-colorable, mattn/go-runewidth, mattn/go-shellwords, robfig/cron/v3, santhosh-tekuri/jsonschema/v6, yuin/goldmark, go.yaml.in/yaml/v4 v4.0.0-rc.6, golang.org/x/net, x/sync, x/sys) plus 6 indirect; `go 1.26`, `toolchain go1.27.1`; go.sum present (go.mod:3-31). .github/actions/npm-packages/go.mod: 0 dependencies (standard library only). package.json (private workspace root): 1 dependency and 5 devDependencies, package-lock.json lockfileVersion 3, workspaces packages/*, distribution/npm/facade, playground. distribution/npm/facade/package.json: 1 dependency (ansispeck), empty optionalDependencies in the template (11 platform packages are stamped in at pack time; distribution/npm/targets.json). playground/package.json: 12 dependencies and 10 devDependencies. packages/changelog-feed/package.json: 0 dependencies and 2 devDependencies. flake.nix: 1 input (nixpkgs-unstable) locked by flake.lock. Docker bases golang:1.27.0, koalaman/shellcheck-alpine:stable and alpine:3.24, plus unpinned apk python3 and py3-pyflakes (Dockerfile:1-19). pre-commit hook pins go-shellcheck v0.11.1 (.pre-commit-hooks.yaml:32). Update tooling: Dependabot monthly, grouped, for github-actions, gomod, npm and docker (.github/dependabot.yml:4-21) plus Upkeep PRs for generated tables, Go toolchain and go-shellcheck (.github/workflows/upkeep.yml).
code.security_policy: none - no SECURITY.md or equivalent file anywhere in the repository (searched all paths for 'security'); problems are directed to the public issue tracker (README.md:271-275; CONTRIBUTING.md:32-36). Security-related automation that does exist: CodeQL (.github/workflows/codeql.yml), govulncheck in `make lint` (Makefile:70-72; ci.yml:133), Dependabot (.github/dependabot.yml).

claim_checks.claim: Cache safety policies are enabled by default (README.md:9; docs/config.md:120-121).
claim_checks.evidence: linter.go:614-618 appends cache-write-untrusted, cache-call-unrestricted and cache-operation unless disabled; cache_policy.go:3-16 returns true when the key or Policy is nil. CHANGELOG.md:13 warns this can make previously clean workflows exit 1.

claim_checks.claim: Opt-in policy checks exist: require-commit-hash, require-permissions, require-job-timeout, required-actions (README.md:9,265; docs/config.md:311-394).
claim_checks.evidence: linter.go:602-613 registers them only when configured. rule_require_commit_hash.go:10-15,47,89 accepts only 40- or 64-hex refs (and image digests, :41-75) and skips expression and local refs (:37,106-108). rule_require_permissions.go:21-33 only tests that a `permissions:` block exists at workflow or job scope; docs/config.md:373-375 says it does not judge least privilege.

claim_checks.claim: Actions usage check validates `with:` inputs and `steps.{id}.outputs` (README.md:16).
claim_checks.evidence: Only local/self-repository actions (metadata read from the repo: rule_action.go:826-827; docs/checks.md:1993-1994) and entries of the embedded PopularActions map are checked. The lookup key is the exact `owner/repo@ref` string (rule_action.go:444; rule_expression.go:393); the map has about 247 spec keys, none a commit SHA (popular_actions.go:5-7), and docs/checks.md:2041-2042,2081-2082 say fixed-version, HEAD and unknown SHA refs are not supported or resolved online. Outputs of other actions are an open string map (rule_expression.go:397).

claim_checks.claim: ShellCheck and pyflakes integrations check scripts at `run:` (README.md:18).
claim_checks.evidence: ShellCheck runs only for bash/sh steps (rule_shellcheck.go:159; docs/checks.md:1009-1010) and pyflakes only for `shell: python` (rule_pyflakes.go:22). Both are external executables; when missing they are silently disabled and the message appears only with -verbose (linter.go:619-638, :217-223; UPSTREAM.md:66 lists this as still affecting the fork). ShellCheck runs with --norc so .shellcheckrc is ignored (docs/usage.md:102-108).

claim_checks.claim: Security checks cover script injection by untrusted inputs and hard-coded credentials (README.md:19).
claim_checks.evidence: Injection detection uses a fixed list of 20 untrusted properties (expr_insecure.go:102-157); docs/checks.md:1218-1235 lists only 18 and omits github.event.discussion.title/body, so the code is broader than the docs. `inputs.*` is not tracked (UPSTREAM.md:126). The credentials rule inspects only `container:` and `services.*` credentials.password (rule_credentials.go:24-40; docs/checks.md:2237-2239), not secrets in env, with or run.

claim_checks.claim: The project ships attested binaries (README.md:9; docs/install.md:130-134).
claim_checks.evidence: release.yml:45 grants attestations: write and id-token: write; release.yml:71-72 runs actions/attest-build-provenance with subject-checksums set to the GoReleaser SHA-256 checksums file (.goreleaser.yaml:43-45). The attestation is generated from that checksums file. scripts/download-actionlint.bash:129-134 verifies only when an authenticated gh exists and performs no checksum check.

claim_checks.claim: A Docker image is published on GHCR and Docker Hub, and the moving v1 tags pin the action image digest (README.md:9,178-181).
claim_checks.evidence: release.yml:149-189 pushes the CLI image to ghcr.io and docker.io for linux/amd64 and linux/arm64 with sbom: true and provenance: mode=max; the action image goes to ghcr.io only (release.yml:199-237; docs/usage.md:485-488); image digests are attested (release.yml:238-255); release.yml:273-317 rewrites action.yml to `image: docker://ghcr.io/...:action-<version>@<digest>` on a bot commit and force-moves v1 and the minor tag. action.yml:75 at the release tag itself references the image by tag only.

claim_checks.claim: `sarif` is an output format of the GitHub Action (README.md:188); publication to code scanning is not claimed.
claim_checks.evidence: The format exists: cmd/actionlint-action/inputs.go:21,31; lint.go:43-45 injects the canonical SARIF 2.1.0 template (sarif.go:5-11; sarif_template.txt:2-11 names tool driver 'GitHub Actions lint', its version and informationUri). No upload-sarif or code-scanning API step exists in any workflow or document (grep for upload-sarif, code-scanning and security-events finds only the CodeQL workflow's own permission at .github/workflows/codeql.yml:15 and permission-scope tables); the action only returns SARIF in its `output` and `output-file` outputs (cmd/actionlint-action/action.go:107-114).

claim_checks.claim: The README demo section is generated and cannot drift (README.md:41).
claim_checks.evidence: README.md:94 still reports 'This fork 1.16.1' although this revision is v1.17.0 (CHANGELOG.md:7; action.yml:75). The section is refreshed by an Upkeep PR after each release (.github/workflows/upkeep.yml:76-122; CONTRIBUTING.md:305-306) and checked on PRs that touch the README (.github/workflows/readme-demo.yml:3-9), so it lags until that PR merges.

claim_checks.claim: The prebuilt image includes actionlint, ShellCheck and pyflakes (README.md:145; docs/usage.md:467-468).
claim_checks.evidence: Dockerfile:12-19 copies shellcheck from koalaman/shellcheck-alpine:stable (floating tag) and installs python3 and py3-pyflakes via unpinned apk; base images golang:1.27.0 and alpine:3.24 are pinned by tag, not by digest (Dockerfile:1-2,4,14).

benchmarks.what: Conformance of the Go implementation against imported upstream fixtures (actions/languageservices 1,228 cases, actions/runner 24, SchemaStore 67, YAML Test Suite 402) - initial comparison
Same conformance suite after the 2026-09-13 schema audit
benchmarks.metric: agreements and recorded differences over 1,721 cases

Historical speedup from checking files in parallel (v1.3.1, 2021, author's own environment, not a measurement of v1.17.0)
benchmarks.metric: relative run time with 3 workflow files

risks: Pinning versus checking gap: with `require-commit-hash` every remote `uses:` becomes a SHA, but input/output typing and outdated-runtime detection look up the exact `owner/repo@ref` string in an embedded map of major-tag specs (rule_action.go:444-452; rule_expression.go:393; popular_actions.go:5-7) and the docs say SHA refs are not resolved online (docs/checks.md:2041-2042,2081-2082); such steps are skipped with a debug-only log. Composite action files cannot be linted directly from the CLI (UPSTREAM.md:79,88).

Maintenance and change velocity: the fork departs from upstream v1.7.12 (CHANGELOG.md:257) and shipped 12 releases (v1.8.0 to v1.17.0) between 2026-08-19 and 2026-09-13 (CHANGELOG.md:7-234); release metadata names one maintainer (.goreleaser.yaml:182,221); v1.17.0 turned on three new default policies that can make clean workflows exit 1 (CHANGELOG.md:13); the Go library is not semver and a package split is planned (docs/api.md:53-56; docs/design/package-layout.md:1-8,400-441); UPSTREAM.md:15-16,44 records 140 open upstream issues and 9 confirmed gaps in the fork.

External linters are optional and can vanish silently: ShellCheck and pyflakes are not bundled in the binary or npm package (docs/install.md:8-9; distribution/npm/facade/README.md:97-99), are skipped without a normal-mode message when absent (linter.go:619-638; UPSTREAM.md:66), and only bash/sh and python scripts are linted (rule_shellcheck.go:159; rule_pyflakes.go:22). Only the Docker image bundles both (Dockerfile:12-19).

No code-scanning publisher: SARIF exists only as an output format (README.md:188; sarif_template.txt); no upload step or doc exists in the repo, and its CodeQL workflow analyses the repo's own code, not actionlint findings (.github/workflows/codeql.yml:28-54). Built-in reporting paths are GitHub annotations (cmd/actionlint-action/render.go:45-64) and the Problem Matcher (.github/actionlint-matcher.json).

Pinning gaps in the project's own build and CI: Docker base images pinned by tag only, with floating koalaman/shellcheck-alpine:stable and unpinned apk packages (Dockerfile:1-19; hadolint DL3018 ignored at ci.yml:150); unpinned tools `govulncheck@latest` (Makefile:72, run by ci.yml:133), `modernize@latest` (autofix.yml:19), `uv tool install` of pyflakes and pre-commit (ci.yml:28,173) and the hadolint image (ci.yml:150); .mise.toml uses `latest` (lines 4-5). All 90 `uses:` refs under .github are 40-hex SHAs.

Provenance and SBOM details: the attestation is generated from the checksums file (release.yml:71-72); SBOMs are SPDX per archive via Syft with license fields that may be NOASSERTION, no CycloneDX (CONTRIBUTING.md:317-328); no detached signatures or reproducible-build claim, and the builds block sets no -trimpath or mod_timestamp (.goreleaser.yaml:13-36); the download script skips attestation verification without an authenticated gh (scripts/download-actionlint.bash:129-134) and the post-release step passes no GH_TOKEN (release.yml:73-74).

No security policy file found. 5 of 19 workflows request write scopes at workflow level: comment-cop.yml:3-4 (pull_request_target with contents and pull-requests write), major-tag.yml:11-12, expr-conformance-probe.yml:12, changelog-monitor.yml:20-22 (issues write) and codeql.yml:13-15 (security-events write); the rest default to `contents: read` with job-level elevation.

Ecosystem and platform limits: reviewdog/action-actionlint, super-linter and trunk install upstream rhysd/actionlint, not this fork (docs/usage.md:542-544,604-607,741-744); the Docker action is Linux-only and needs a Docker daemon (README.md:145); the macOS binary is not notarized (docs/install.md:79-81); Linux 386/ARM, Windows 386 and FreeBSD builds have no native CI tests (docs/install.md:116-120); WinGet is pending (docs/install.md:327-337); the module path is a vanity domain resolved by a go-import tag on the Pages site (playground/index.html:10) and the YAML parser dependency is a release candidate (go.mod:18).
